decisions.reason: As a close-to-core extension into offshore and renewable vessel management, it fits the firm's expansion path and large resource base, so absent clear evidence of performance below aspiration management would likely continue it rather than reallocate the unit's capabilities.

Crew and corporate travel management is highly adjacent to the firm's established crew and administrative services, so it likely meets a satisfactory aspiration level with low additional risk and is therefore likely to be retained.

The online vessel information portal supports the core management offer and customer proximity strategy, and a large expanding firm with some slack would usually give such a complementary digital service more time unless results clearly fall short of aspirations.

The mobile vessel performance app is somewhat more uncertain because it is a more digital, less traditional service for this industry, but it still supports safer and more efficient operations, so management would more likely keep it while monitoring whether it reaches acceptable performance.
